about_short_description.short_description: Glance Care specializes in developing SaaS products to reduce medical claims rejection and reclaim denied revenue.

product.name: GlanceClaim™
product.description: A medical claims auditing solution that detects and resolves medical and technical vulnerabilities to reduce claim rejections and revenue leakage.

product.name: Omni Web and DynSet API
product.description: An AI-powered clinical decision support system providing real-time, evidence-based order set recommendations and alerts to improve diagnostic accuracy and patient safety.

product.name: Glance Insight
product.description: A healthcare business analytics platform that provides data-driven insights for strategic decision-making, revenue optimization, and operational efficiency.

identifier.value: Clinical Documentation Improvement Solutions (CodeAudit API, Moramiz API, DocuGen API)

product.name: Clinical Documentation Improvement Solutions (CodeAudit API, Moramiz API, DocuGen API)
product.description: A suite of APIs that enhance clinical documentation accuracy, coding compliance, and medical note generation to reduce errors and improve revenue capture.

identifier.value: Revenue Cycle Management Solutions (Claim API, PreAuth API, Claim Web)

product.name: Revenue Cycle Management Solutions (Claim API, PreAuth API, Claim Web)
product.description: A set of tools for auditing medical claims, managing prior authorizations, and validating claims to reduce denials and improve financial accuracy.
